title-info.book-title: The North Wind and the Sun

title.p: The North Wind and the Sun

epigraph.p: Pride, said the Sun, yields where warmth persists.

section.p: The North Wind and the Sun disputed which was the stronger, while a traveler walked the road wrapped in a warm cloak.
They agreed that the one who first made the traveler take off his cloak should be counted the stronger.

poem.v: The wind blew; the cloak stayed.
The sun shone; the cloak fell.

section.p: Then the Sun shone out warmly, and immediately the traveler took off his cloak.
